The registry needs htpasswd auth — docker run --rm httpd:2.4 htpasswd -Bbn dojo docker-master > /tmp/htpasswd generates the credentials file; create the Secret with kubectl create secret generic registry-auth --from-file=htpasswd=/tmp/htpasswd -n dojo-docker-registry

Deploy registry:2.8.3 with REGISTRY_AUTH=htpasswd, REGISTRY_AUTH_HTPASSWD_REALM, REGISTRY_AUTH_HTPASSWD_PATH=/auth/htpasswd env vars and mount the registry-auth Secret at /auth. Create a ClusterIP Service registry-svc on port 5000, then port-forward to push images from outside

For the registry-consumer pod: create a docker-registry Secret (imagePullSecrets) pointing to registry-svc.dojo-docker-registry.svc.cluster.local:5000 with username=dojo password=docker-master, then create the Pod spec referencing that secret and your pushed image
